title: Reports on the iPhone 18 Pro Max Price
description: Recent news coverage highlights potential price increases for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 17, alongside reports of manufacturing challenges for Apple chips.

sections.heading: iPhone 18 Pro Pricing
paragraphs: According to El Periódico, the price of the Apple iPhone 18 Pro is soaring.

sections.heading: iPhone 17 Price Alert
paragraphs: Applesfera reports a warning of a possible price increase for the iPhone 17 today, noting it is just one month before the next keynote.

sections.heading: Chip Manufacturing Challenges
paragraphs: Xataka reports that Apple has a billion dollars in chips it cannot finish. According to Tim Culpan, the issue is attributed to how Apple decided to package them.
